subject: maths
question:
The given pie chart represents the percentage distribution of the number of sandwiches sold by a shopkeeper on different days of a week.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5d50e7d6cdfd71ab56b7a1e22098cd415d6a3b4baba64b4a89ec49f7e0ee515.png] 

The total number of sandwiches sold on Tuesday is what percentage of the total number of sandwiches sold on Saturday?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The total number of sandwiches sold on Tuesday = 8%

The total number of sandwiches sold on Saturday = 16%

Required % = (8/16) × 100

⇒ 50%

**∴ The required answer is 50%.**
